checks_run: Inventoried and statically reviewed all 37 candidate files, including the contract, learner material, sealed reference, tests, tooling, provenance, and validation claims.
Probed every configured toolchain root by absolute path and recorded exact versions; used pinned Python and configured QEMU for validation.
Ran the structure/credential audit and independently checked manifest/provenance cross-references, canonical provenance digest, file types, and artifact cleanliness.
Built the sealed reference twice and the learner stub once, compared hashes and bytes, and inspected ELF architecture, linkage, entry point, and GNU_STACK permissions.
Ran 10 public tests, 14 sealed boundary tests, and 6 build/audit tooling regression tests with bounded subprocesses.

Ran a deterministic reviewer-authored model and adversarial harness covering 830 modeled operations, 15 targeted failures, all 33 separator bytes, near-numeric names, and 300 seeded arbitrary-byte inputs.
Compared a nested-control workload natively and under configured qemu-x86_64 and smoke-checked the explicitly unvalidated benchmark harness.
Verified the intentional starter behavior and rechecked the candidate tree digest before and after validation.
evidence: Both independent reference builds were byte-identical with SHA-256 b3e847dcfb3579a3a0029836ca3ea590076cad4399d714beae4ac38a95878092; the starter hash was 72a0205dee22854aa726e476e3e61f01886d037a1aa324b2169034e1c3c017ff.
Public 10/10, sealed 14/14, and tooling 6/6 tests passed with no skips.
The repaired overflowing-decimal-prefix cases returned status 0 and exact stdout 7\n8\n; the complete-token lexical pass and permanent regression cases are present.
The independent harness passed 830 model assertions, five successful contract programs, 15 expected-error cases, 300 robustness cases, and native/QEMU equivalence.
The audit reported 37 required regular files, 21 forbidden paths absent, exact manifest and provenance objects, four credential patterns, and no special entries.
The reference is a static x86-64 ELF with global _start, no dynamic section, and a non-executable RW GNU_STACK.
Manifest status remains GENERATED with GENERATED and PARTIAL only, productionized is false, benchmark output says UNVALIDATED_MEASUREMENT, and stronger validation labels are explicitly disclaimed.
limitations: The immutable source-catalog snapshot and linked upstream resource were unavailable, so source commit, CC0 evidence, NOASSERTION status, similarity, and clean-room authorship could not be independently authenticated.

Learner-view filtering is an external control-plane property; this review verified organization and absence of obvious leaks outside sealed/, but did not transfer-verify a separately materialized learner view.
Generated material has a stated personal-educational-use boundary but no top-level license grant; broader reuse rights were not established.
The x86-64 build uses recorded host /usr/bin/as and /usr/bin/ld.bfd rather than a configured immutable x86 toolchain root, so byte reproducibility was established only in this environment.

No coverage-guided fuzzing, sanitizer run, validated performance study, production/security review, or broader OS/architecture matrix was performed; the seeded robustness run does not confer a FUZZED label.
Historical comparisons against PRIOR_BUILD and PRIOR_REVIEW could not be replayed because those inputs are not part of CANDIDATE.
